source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The scope I need, however, is a Fullstack solution: a web app, a mobile app, and an admin panel.

routing_warnings.description: The message reports that hosted testing is unavailable because the backend has not been deployed; it does not establish failure of the Android application.
The client is asking where to find the Flutter application source code, which concerns source-code delivery rather than Android application behavior.
The freelancer identifies the location of the frontend source code but does not claim that an Android build was completed or verified.
The message separately proposes releasing the application on Google Play, which belongs to the store-release Requirement rather than the Android application deliverable.
